copy.heroHeading: Twenty-eight years of doing it properly
story: Wong Ah Sang started laying tile in Klang in 1998, working alone out of a van. He built the business on wet works — the unglamorous screeding, tiling and waterproofing that decides whether everything above it lasts.

His son runs it now, with 26 tradesmen on the payroll rather than day hire. We have no showroom and we do not produce 3D drawings. What we have is men who have done this for twenty years and a phone number that has not changed since 2004.

testimonials.quote: Four contractors could not find where the leak was coming from. Old Mr Wong found it in one afternoon. Turned out to be the flashing, not the tiles at all.
testimonials.name: Ganesh Pillai

testimonials.quote: My parents used them in 2004. I used them last year for my own house. Same family, same standard of tiling. That says everything.
testimonials.name: Jasmine Lee

testimonials.quote: Not fancy, no showroom, no 3D drawings. But the workmanship is the best I have seen in twenty years of owning property in Klang.
testimonials.name: Hamid Osman

process.title: Come and Look
process.text: We visit, look properly, and tell you honestly what needs doing and what does not. If a repair will do instead of a replacement, we will say so — we have never needed to sell work that isn't necessary.

process.title: Written Quotation
process.text: An itemised quotation on paper, priced by measured quantity. Our prices are not the lowest in Klang and we will not pretend otherwise; what they are is the price you will actually pay at the end.

process.title: Our Own Men
process.text: Every tradesman on your job is on our payroll, led by one foreman from first day to handover. Payment follows completed stages, and we come back if something is not right.
